title: Colorful Moon
description: Adds subtle color to The Moon.
body:
### About
A simple resource pack that re-textures the Moon to have a subtle splash of color, while keeping the style of the vanilla Moon.

This pack does **not** require any mods to work.

![The Moon now has a subtle pink hue with splashes of orange, yellow, purple, and blue](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/499af9fc508179f2c943084964439b9d6a5ddb3c.png)

## 
### Compatibility
This pack is compatible with shaders as long as they retain the vanilla Moon, or have an option to do so. [Complementary](https://modrinth.com/shader/complementary-reimagined) and [Bliss](https://modrinth.com/shader/bliss-shader) shaders work wonderfully.

This pack *should* be compatible with any mods that use the vanilla Moon texture.

## 
### Credits
This pack was inspired by [Ildar Ibatullin](https://www.instagram.com/_ibatullin_ildar_)'s photos of the Moon.

##
### Usage
You may feature this resource pack in videos or modpacks with proper credit (a link to this page).
